Rina (partnerships): morning — quick ops check for marketplace launch next week. need alignment on blog post publish window, hero CTA variants, and SI technical preview timing. who can confirm?
Kai (marketing): i'll own the blog + hero CTAs. planning two CTAs: 'Try the integration' (partner-forward) and 'Explore Redwood' (neutral). will push drafts by 11am PT.
Hector (product): staging page updated at staging.redwood.com/marketplace-next. missing partner-auth flow snippet and partner logo svg. if not received by 2pm PT i'll swap to neutral visuals.
Tess (solutions): SI preview sessions: we can schedule 30-min technical previews Tue/Wed mornings. need partner test creds and a sample dataset. prefer live demo if creds arrive, otherwise we'll record.
Priya (legal): legal needs final blog copy + partner quote signoff at least 24h before publish. embargo details must be explicit in partner agreement.
Rina (partnerships): embargo tentatively Tue 16:00 PT. partners must submit assets & signed quote by Mon 16:00 PT or we default to neutral CTA and community blog.
Kai (marketing): noted. i'll include a fallback excerpt for the blog that omits partner mentions. also prepping social microcopy.
Hector (product): small UX note: if logo missing the hero spacing collapses. i'll add placeholder and a max-height to prevent jumps.
Tess (solutions): pinged SI partner for creds at 1829876600, they said "aiming EOD". if no creds i'll schedule recorded demo and a follow-up technical office hours.
launch-bot: created task RED-LAUNCH-3001: "Marketplace launch - blog + SI preview" assigned to Kai/Hector/Tess, due 2024-09-10 16:00 PT. https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/RED-LAUNCH-3001
Rina (partnerships): checklist copy here:
- Embargo: Tue 16:00 PT
- Blog draft + hero CTA variants: Kai -> 11:00am PT
- Partner assets (logo SVG, auth snippet): Partner -> Mon 14:00 PT
- Partner quote signed: Partner -> Priya review -> Mon 16:00 PT
- SI creds + dataset: Partner -> Tess -> prefer today EOD
- Staging placeholder for missing logo: Hector -> deploy by 15:00 PT

Kai (marketing): drafting headline ideas: 
1) "Redwood + PartnerName: inference at scale"
2) "Run LLM inference where your data lives"
Posting in thread for feedback.
Priya (legal): avoid partner financial claims in headline unless partner supplies figures and signs off. prefer neutral headline if unsure.
Hector (product): added placeholder CSS, deploying in 10m. will post when done.
Tess (solutions): got partial creds at 1829876780 (token only). working with partner for endpoint URL. i'll update in 15m.
Rina (partnerships): good progress. final decision rule: if partner assets + signed quote present by Mon 16:00 PT we proceed with partner co-announcement. otherwise, we run neutral blog + social and schedule partner spotlight later.
Kai (marketing): will also prepare an asset-light blog variant for same-day publish in case we need it.
Hector (product): staging patch live at 1829876860. placeholder logo in place.
Tess (solutions): confirmed creds + endpoint at 1829876900. demo env standing by. scheduling technical preview for Tue 09:30 PT.
Rina (partnerships): thanks team. i'll send partner the embargo clause & deadlines now. ping here if anything slips. :pray:
